screen.reason: The paper describes the development and evaluation (including expert ophthalmologist ratings) of ChatOCT, a compressed, domain-adapted LLM for embedded optical coherence tomography decision support in resource-limited settings. It tests model development/compression performance rather than comparing health-system deployment practices or safeguards.
